body:
I was able to reproduce this. Furthermore, sometimes the error `ERROR: editor/debugger/script_editor_debugger.cpp:567 - Condition "output_strings.size() != output_types.size()" is true.` gets printed. Also, when that error gets printed, the output to the OS native console and Godot's built-in console oftentimes does not match, with the error getting printed to the OS native console later than in Godot's built-in console, to the point where there is a small chance of the error getting printed to the OS native console at the _exact same time_ as the backtrace, messing up the colors and, in a subset of cases, the formatting.
It is also possible, albeit rare, to get a bunch of Unicode parsing error as a result of this race (click this line to see example). Script: ```gdscript extends Node func _process(b) -> void: var a: PackedStringArray print(1) await get_tree().process_frame print(2) await get_tree().process_frame print(3) await get_tree().process_frame ``` Output to OS native console: ``` ... 3 2 1 Unicode parsing error: Invalid unicode codepoint (7dd79eb0) Unicode parsing error, some characters were replaced with � (U+FFFD): Invalid unicode codepoint (ffffffff), cannot represent as UTF-8 Unicode parsing error: Invalid unicode codepoint (7dd7a0d0) Unicode parsing error: Invalid unicode codepoint (7dd79cd0) took me 187 attempts until and including the attempt where I got the above output. End of `Unicode parsing error` note.
Script used to reproduce the below output: ```gdscript extends Node func _ready() -> void: var a: PackedStringArray print(1) await get_tree().process_frame print(2) await get_tree().process_frame print(3) await get_tree().process_frame print(4) await get_tree().process_frame print(5) await get_tree().process_frame print(6) await get_tree().process_frame print(7) await get_tree().process_frame print(8) await get_tree().process_frame print(9) await get_tree().process_frame print(10) await get_tree().process_frame print(11) ``` Example output to the OS native console from running the above script as part of a scene in which the script was attached to the scene's root and only node: ``` 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 ERROR: Condition "output_strings.size() != output_types.size()" is true. at: _msg_output (editor/debugger/script_editor_debugger.cpp:567) 9 10 ================================================================ CrashHandlerException: Program crashed with signal 11 Engine version: Godot Engine v4.7.dev2.official (778cf54dabd8a9e25b698a87036ab8604183f303) Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug on: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues [1] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable [2] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable ... [22] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable -- END OF C++ BACKTRACE -- ================================================================ ``` While the above was output to the OS native console, this was output to Godot's built-in console: ``` Godot Engine v4.7.dev2.official.778cf54da - https://godotengine.org D3D12 12_0 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 1 2 ERROR: editor/debugger/script_editor_debugger.cpp:567 - Condition "output_strings.size() != output_types.size()" is true. 4 5 6 7 8 9 --- Debugging process stopped --- ```
